DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: まずこの紙で筆の動きを試してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Subukan muna ang galaw ng brush sa papel na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: もう花に色を塗りました。これを額に入れて持ち帰る作品にするのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 練習紙を持ち帰り作品だと思ったことを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nakukulayan ko na po ang bulaklak. Ito ba ang i-frame at iuuwi kong likha?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pag-aakalang final take-home artwork ang practice paper. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その紙は練習用です。本番の材料は、練習の後でお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Pangpraktis iyan. Ibibigay ang tunay na materyal pagkatapos ng praktis.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 完成品の下絵だと思っていました。今の紙は練習として続け、本番の材料にはまだ触れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 練習と本番を分け本番材料にまだ触れないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po sketch ng final. Itutuloy ito bilang praktis at hindi muna gagalawin ang tunay na materyal.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang praktis at final at huwag muna hawakan ang final material. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。筆に水を含ませすぎると色が広がります。今の線を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Kapag sobrang tubig sa brush, kumakalat ang kulay. Tingnan ang linya ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 線の外へ色が出ています。本番前に、水を減らした状態でもう一本試してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 水分過多を観察し減らした筆で再練習を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Lumampas po ang kulay. Maaari bang isa pang linya nang mas kaunting tubig bago ang final?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Obserbahan ang sobrang tubig at humiling ng muling praktis sa mas tuyong brush. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その空いているところで試しましょう。筆の水分はこちらで調整を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Sa bakanteng bahagi subukan. Ipapakita ko ang pag-aayos ng tubig.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この状態なら線が広がりにくいですね。練習した花と本番の模様は同じにする必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 練習と本番の模様選択の関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi gaanong kumakalat sa ganito. Kailangan po bang pareho ang bulaklak sa praktis at pattern sa final?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang ugnayan ng practice at final pattern. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 選べる模様を本番前にご案内します。練習用の花に決めた扱いにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapakita ang mapipiliang pattern bago ang final. Hindi pa napiling final ang practice flower.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では模様の説明を聞いて選びます。練習紙は比較用に手元へ置き、本番材料が来るまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 模様説明後に選び材料到着まで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakikinggan ko po saka pipili. Itatabi ang practice para ihambing at maghihintay ng materyal.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pumili matapos ang pattern guide at maghintay ng materyal. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備してお持ちします。筆はこの受け皿へ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ihahanda at dadalhin. Ilagay ang brush sa platitong ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の品はこちらです。掛け紙はまだ付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ito ang reserved item. Wala pang gift paper band.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約は私の名前ですが、会社からの贈り物です。掛け紙にも私の名前が入るのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約者名と贈り主名義の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pangalan ko po ang reservation pero regalo ng kompanya. Pangalan ko rin ba sa paper band?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang reservation name at giver name. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約のお名前をそのまま掛け紙へ使うとは限りません。入れる名義を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi awtomatikong reservation name. Matitiyak ang ilalagay na pangalan?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名にしたいです。予約名を変更するのではなく、掛け紙の名義だけ別にお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約記録を維持し掛け紙だけ会社名にしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Company name po. Hindi booking name ang papalitan kundi paper band lang, maaari?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang reservation at humiling ng company name sa paper band lamang. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。会社名の正式な表記をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Itatanong sa staff. May pormal na spelling ng kompanya?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名刺があります。この表記でお願いします。会社の略称は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名刺で正式表記を示し略称を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: May business card po. Gamitin ito, huwag ang abbreviation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang pormal na spelling sa business card at huwag abbreviation. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表記を控えました。宛先のお名前も掛け紙へ入れるご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Naitala. Ilalagay din ang recipient name?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、そこは不要です。会社名だけ入れ、包装する前に文字を見せていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛名は不要とし包装前の文字確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po kailangan. Company lang at pakipakita ang sulat bago balutin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing walang recipient at humiling ng text check bago balot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が作成したものをお見せします。菓子の数量は予約どおりでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapakita ang ginawa ng staff. Pareho ang dami ng sweets sa reservation?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、数量は変えません。掛け紙の会社名を確認してから、予約分を受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 数量を維持し名義確認後に受け取ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, walang pagbabago. Titingnan ang company name saka kukunin ang reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Panatilihin ang dami at tanggapin matapos name check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。名義の確認が済むまで包装を進めずお待ちします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Hindi ibabalot hanggang matapos ang pagtiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この糸端を、次の工程の前に整えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aayusin ang dulong sinulid bago ang susunod na hakbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 糸を切ると聞こえましたが、張ってある縦糸を全部切るという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 糸を切る範囲の理解を問い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Narinig ko pong putulin; lahat ba ng nakaunat na patayong sinulid?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong muli ang saklaw ng pagputol. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いいえ。今示しているのは端に出た余分な部分です。張ってある糸には手を入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi. Sobrang lumalabas sa dulo ang itinuturo. Huwag hawakan ang nakaunat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 範囲を取り違えていました。はさみはまだ使っていません。対象を一本ずつ指して確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未着手を報告し実物で対象を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mali po ang saklaw ko. Hindi pa ginamit ang gunting; gusto kong ituro isa-isa para matiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Iulat na hindi pa nagawa at humiling ng aktuwal na target check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認は私が実物で示します。機械を動かしたまま手を近づけないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ako ang magpapakita sa aktuwal. Huwag ilapit ang kamay habang umaandar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 停止してから、担当の確認を受けて見ます。隣の布にも同じ作業をしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止と担当確認を優先し隣の布への適用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pagkahinto at pagtiyak po ng staff titingin. Pareho rin ba sa katabing tela?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unahin ang hinto at staff check at itanong ang katabing tela. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 隣の布は別の工程です。今回はこの一枚だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ibang hakbang ang katabi. Itong isang tela lang ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この一枚に限ります。切った糸端を布の上に残すと混ざるので、回収先も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作業を一枚に限定し切った糸の回収先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isa lang po. Mahahalo ang pinutol kung nasa tela; pakituro rin ang koleksiyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Limitahan sa isa at itanong ang lagayan ng putol na sinulid. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 回収はこの容器です。まず一か所、私と確認してから作業を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa lalagyang ito. Unang isang lugar muna nating tiyakin bago ituloy.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。停止と対象確認を済ませ、最初の一か所を一緒に確認してから続けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初の一か所を共同確認してから続けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Hinto at target muna, at sabay sa unang isa bago magpatuloy.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabay na tiyakin ang unang lugar bago magpatuloy. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その順番で始めましょう。判断がつかない糸は切らずに呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan ang simula. Huwag putulin ang hindi tiyak; tawagin ako.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 目的地の住所は分かりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この建物です。足を痛めているので、正門に止めてもらえばすぐ入れると思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩行負担と正門で降りたい想定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Itong gusali. Masakit po ang paa ko kaya akala ko sa main gate ay diretso nang makapasok.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang hirap sa lakad at palagay na sa main gate bababa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 正門から建物まで距離がある場合もあります。使える入口の案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring malayo ang gusali mula main gate. May guide ng usable entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約案内に来客入口とあります。正門と同じか分からないので、施設に確認してから乗りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来客入口の違いを施設へ確認してから乗りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Visitor entrance po sa booking guide. Hindi ko alam kung pareho, kaya sa facility muna bago sumakay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing titiyakin ang visitor entrance sa facility bago sumakay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗る前に確認しましょう。こちらで待つ間、列の進み方は係に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin muna. Habang naghihintay, itanong sa staff ang pila.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 係の方に一度列を外れると伝えます。施設へは、車で近づける入口も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列を外れる連絡と車の接近可否の確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sasabihin kong aalis muna sa pila. Itatanong din sa facility ang entrance na malalapitan ng kotse.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaalam ang pag-alis sa pila at itanong ang car access. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認ができたら、運転者へ入口名と案内を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Kapag alam na, ipakita sa driver ang entrance name at guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 施設から入口名を聞けましたが、停車できる場所は運転者に確認する必要があるそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 入口は判明し停車場所は未確定と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Nalaman ko po ang entrance pero sa driver daw titiyakin ang puwedeng hintuan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iulat na alam na ang entrance ngunit hindi pa ang stopping point. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、運転者と相談して乗車を決めてください。住所の画面も残しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kumonsulta sa driver bago magpasya sumakay. Panatilihin ang address screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、住所と入口名を両方見せます。正門への停車を先に決めつけず、降車場所を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所と入口名で運転者に降車場所を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo, pareho kong ipapakita. Hindi main gate agad; pag-usapan ang babaan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gamit ang address at entrance, itanong sa driver ang babaan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたら係にお声掛けください。列への戻り方を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Magsabi sa staff kapag handa. Ituturo ang pagbalik sa pila.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このポンプが押せません。固まっているので、壊れている商品ではありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 押せないポンプを故障かと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi po mapindot ang pump. Matigas; sira po ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung sira ang hindi mapindot na pump. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 輸送中に押されないよう固定されているタイプか、表示を確認しましょう。売場の商品を無理に押さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan kung locked para sa biyahe. Huwag piliting pindutin ang sale product.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ買っていない商品でした。押すのをやめます。使い始める時の解除方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未購入品を押すのを止め解除方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po binibili. Hihinto at gusto kong malaman ang pag-unlock sa unang gamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itigil ang pagpindot sa unpurchased at itanong ang unlock. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材の見本では、上部を指定方向へ回して解除します。実演用の見本で示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa sample sa materyal na ito, iikot ang itaas sa takdang direksiyon. Demo sample ang ipapakita.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売っている方ではなく見本でお願いします。押せないから水を足す必要がある、とも思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演見本を指定し水追加の思い込みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa sample po at hindi sale item. Akala ko rin kailangang dagdagan ng tubig kapag hindi mapindot.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliin ang demo at sabihin ang palagay na magdagdag ng tubig. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 固定の解除と、中身を薄めることは別です。この商品は表示にない水の追加をしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Magkaiba ang unlocking at dilution. Huwag magdagdag ng tubig na wala sa label.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水は足しません。見本の上部が上がる位置を確認して、表示の手順どおりに使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 希釈せず解除位置と表示手順を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po magdadagdag. Titingnan ang pag-angat ng sample top at susundin ang label.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag palabnawin at tiyakin ang unlock position at steps. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち帰る時は、未開封の商品を選んでください。見本は販売品ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sa pag-uwi, pumili ng hindi pa bukas. Hindi binibenta ang sample.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。解除した見本を買うのではなく、未開封の一本を選びます。家で最初に表示を読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本と販売品を分け未開封一本を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hindi ang unlocked sample; isang sealed bottle. Babasahin muli ang label sa bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang sample at sale at pumili ng isang sealed bottle. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未開封の商品はこちらです。使い方の表示を残してお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ito ang sealed. Itabi ang use label sa pag-uwi.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更のご相談ですね。お引越しはお済みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 賃貸契約を昨日結びました。新しい住所へ今日変更できると思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 契約日を理由に住所変更できると考えたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pumirma po ng lease kahapon kaya akala ko mapapalitan ngayon sa bagong address.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang palagay na puwedeng magpalit dahil lease date. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約した日と実際に住み始めた日は違うことがあります。入居のご予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaaring iba ang contract date at tunay na pagtira. Kailan ang plano?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入居は来月です。今は以前の住所に住んでいます。新住所を現住所として申し出る段階ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入居は来月で現住所は旧住所だと整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Susunod na buwan po. Nasa dati pa; hindi pa ang bagong address bilang current.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Linawing next month ang move-in at luma pa ang current. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な手続きや書類は担当が確認します。今日ほかに変更したい情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang magtitingin sa kailangan. May iba pang babaguhin ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話番号はもう変わっています。住所の予定変更と分けて、現在の電話番号の手続きを相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更済み電話番号の手続きを別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nagbago na po ang phone. Hiwalay sa planned address, maaari bang current phone procedure?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hiwalay itanong ang nagbago nang phone number. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの変更について案内します。新居の契約書だけで本人確認が完了するとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Iba-ibang change ang ituturo. Hindi laging sapat ang lease sa identity check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持参した本人確認書類を見ていただきたいです。新住所の契約書を現在の居住証明とは説明しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認書類を示し契約書の意味を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakitingnan po ang ID na dala. Hindi ko tatawaging current residence proof ang lease.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang ID at limitahan ang ibig sabihin ng kontrata. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が確認します。住所については、実際の転居時に必要な手順も聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff ang titingin. Maitatanong ang address steps sa aktuwal na paglipat.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では今日は電話番号の変更条件を確認し、住所は入居後の手順をメモします。変更済みとは家族にまだ伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話番号の条件と入居後の住所手順を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Phone conditions po ngayon at memo ng address after move-in. Hindi ko sasabihin sa pamilya na changed na.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hiwalay tiyakin ang phone conditions at post-move address steps. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順でご案内します。二つの情報を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-TAITO-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ganiyan ang pagkakasunod. Hiwalay ang dalawa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送する封筒はこちらですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ここで封をして出したいです。中には署名した書類のコピーを入れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名書類のコピー入り封筒を出したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Isasara rito at ipapadala; kopya ng signed document ang laman.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing ipapadala ang sobre na may copy ng signed document. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先がコピーでよいかは、郵便局では判断できません。提出案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi post office ang makapagpapasya kung puwede ang copy. May submission guide?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。署名済み原本と書いてありました。自分の控えを送るつもりになっていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出案内を読み原本指定と控えの取り違いに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mayroon po. Signed original pala. Sarili kong kopya ang ipapadala ko sana.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Basahin ang original requirement at mapansin ang mix-up sa sariling copy. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ封は閉じていませんね。内容を確認してから発送方法をご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Hindi pa sarado, tama? Pagkatapos matiyak ang laman, pag-usapan ang shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 原本は家にあります。ここで署名をコピーに足して済ませず、原本を取りに戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代用署名をせず家の原本を取りに戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nasa bahay po ang original. Hindi dagdag-pirma sa copy; kukunin ko ang original.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag substitute signature at kunin ang original sa bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今日はまだ発送しないということでよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。締切も家の書類で確認し、戻る時には原本と自分の控えを別の袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送を保留し締切確認と原本控えの分別を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Sa bahay titingnan ang deadline at sa pagbalik hiwalay na supot ang original at copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban at tiyakin ang deadline at paghihiwalay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先の記入済み封筒はお持ち帰りください。発送方法は書類がそろってから案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: Iuwi ang addressed envelope. Shipping kapag kumpleto.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。封筒は持ち帰り、原本の確認後に発送方法と到着目安を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒を持ち帰り原本確認後に発送方法を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Iuuwi at pagkatapos ng original check itatanong ang shipping at arrival estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iuwi ang sobre at itanong ang shipping matapos original check. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。中身の提出条件は提出先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-UENO-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Sa submit-to office tiyakin ang content conditions.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車の方はどなたですか。

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけです。家族の鞄まで持ってきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見送り客の鞄との混在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ako lang. Pati bag ng pamilya nadala ko.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang paghahalo sa bag ng taga-hatid. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらが車内へ持ち込む荷物ですか。

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この小さい方です。大きい方は家族へ返します。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持込鞄と返す鞄を指示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong maliit. Ibabalik ang malaki sa pamilya.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ituro ang dadalhin at ibabalik. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 扉の前で渡さず、脇で確認してください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag sa tapat ng pinto; sa gilid tiyakin.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。中の弁当だけ、小さい鞄へ移したいです。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 弁当だけ移したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Bento lang sa loob ang ililipat ko sana sa maliit.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing bento lamang ang nais ilipat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 発車まで余裕はありますか。

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今から移すと慌てそうです。弁当は手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時間不足で手持ちに変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mukhang mamadaliin kung ililipat pa. Sa kamay ang bento.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Lumipat sa hand-carry dahil kulang ang oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗る鞄は確認できましたか。

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。小さい鞄と弁当を持ち、大きい鞄は返しました。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 乗車する荷物の整理完了を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Maliit at bento ang dala at naibalik ang malaki.
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing tapos na ang pag-aayos ng sasakay na gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご自分の荷物だけ持ってお乗りください。
DLG-SC-TOY-TAKAOKA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sarili ninyong gamit lang ang dalhin pagsakay.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査記録は書けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Kaya bang isulat ang inspection record?

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 測定器の数字と用紙の単位が違うようです。このまま写してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録用紙と測定単位の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Parang iba po ang unit sa instrument at form. Maaari bang kopyahin nang ganoon?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang unit difference sa record at instrument. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 厚さの欄です。数字は読めますが、表示単位を確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 数字を読めるが単位不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kapal po. Nababasa ang numero pero hindi tiyak ang display unit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nababasa ang numero ngunit hindi alam ang unit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 推測で換算せず、検査担当に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Huwag manghula ng conversion; itanong sa inspector.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。未確認の数値に合格印は付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合否記入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo. Hindi ko lalagyan ng pass mark ang hindi tiyak na value.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang pass/fail entry. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 測定した品は区別してありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別のトレーに置きました。検査待ちと表示してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象品の分離と表示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa ibang tray po. Maaari bang waiting inspection ang label?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong ang separation at label ng item. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に表示方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Itatanong pati ang label sa staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。単位がわかったら、同じ品をもう一度測ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の再測定を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Kapag alam ang unit, susukatin uli ang parehong item.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mag-alok ng remeasurement matapos matiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その品と記録を残してお待ちください。担当確認後に記入を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Itabi ang item at record at maghintay. Saka isulat matapos staff check.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 仕上げに入ってよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前に、この指の跡が気になります。消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指跡の修正可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bago po iyon, may fingerprint dito. Matatanggal ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maaayos ang fingerprint. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 直すと、周りの模様も変わることがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kapag inayos, maaaring magbago pati paligid na pattern.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 跡だけ消すのは難しいのですね。今の模様は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 周囲の模様を守りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mahirap po palang marka lang. Gusto kong iwan ang kasalukuyang pattern.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais ingatan ang paligid na pattern. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の作品の印として残す方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puwedeng iwan bilang marka ng sariling likha.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それもよいですね。触った場所が思い出になるので残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体験の印として指跡を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Maganda rin po. Alaala ang hinawakan kaya iiwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Iwan ang fingerprint bilang tanda ng karanasan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕上げ後は表面を変えにくくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Mahirap nang baguhin ang ibabaw pagkatapos finishing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。今の状態を一度写真に撮って確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕上げ前の撮影確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Opo. Gusto kong kunan muna ang kasalukuyan at tingnan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humiling ng photo check bago finishing. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮ってからお知らせください。

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認しました。跡を残したまま、仕上げをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の仕上げを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ko po. Iwan ang marka at pakitapos.
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Humiling ng finishing matapos matiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。この状態で仕上げに進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TOY-TAKAOKA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Itutuloy ang finishing sa kalagayang ito.
